title: Kando — Start Menu Test
script: I tested Kando against the Start menu on ten everyday tasks. The list stays fixed: launch apps, open folders, and reach common commands. I counted setup separately, practiced both methods, then alternated three timed rounds. I logged wrong selections too. Fast clicking does not help if I open the wrong thing. Kando took [KANDO_MEDIAN]. Start took [START_MEDIAN]. [MISCLICK_AND_SETUP_RESULT]. [EVIDENCE_BASED_FIT]. Would the setup be worth it for your workflow?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Ten identical tasks; time, setup, learning curve, misclicks and resources.
whyNow: A practical alternative deserves a current, version-specific check before a viewer changes workflow.
viewerGoal: Decide whether this recorded workflow fits their own devices, plan and needs.
hooks: I tested Kando against the Start menu on ten everyday tasks.
Does a radial menu beat the Start menu?
Setup takes time too. I counted it.
strongestHook: I tested Kando against the Start menu on ten everyday tasks.
directorBrief: Direct this as a fair matched test with a scoped recommendation: Ten identical tasks; time, setup, learning curve, misclicks and resources. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: Use the exact ten actions from discovery. Time setup separately. Practice both methods for five minutes. Alternate Start/Kando order across three rounds, same initial desktop state and app cache condition. Start at invocation, stop at usable target. Include correction time for wrong selections. Log task-level durations, round totals, median/range, wrong selections and idle memory snapshots. Recommendation depends on observed benefit and setup cost.
evidenceRequirements: Record both methods and actual timers; leave scores blank until tested.
